nodes.description: No disease-modifying, pharmacological, gene, or cell therapy exists for RIN2 syndrome and no clinical trial has been conducted. Management is symptomatic and multidisciplinary: orthopaedic bracing or surgery for progressive scoliosis, physiotherapy for joint hypermobility, dental/periodontal care for gingival overgrowth, hearing support, airway clearance for bronchiectasis, and hormone replacement for hypergonadotropic hypogonadism.

RIN2-related intracellular trafficking defects disturb extracellular-matrix homeostasis across non-cutaneous connective tissues, underlying the Ehlers-Danlos-overlapping musculoskeletal laxity, progressive scoliosis, gingival and dental connective-tissue abnormalities, and occasional airway wall weakness (bronchiectasis), although individual tissue-level intermediates have not been biopsied outside skin.
